claire_cs: quick note  CedarBridge dry-run hit three small blockers: telemetry egress, KMS permissions, CloudTrail forwarding. dropping TL;DR so we can patch runbook.
noah_net: what failed?
claire_cs: telemetry timed out; they opened egress to 0.0.0.0/0 because our example lacked a suggested public CIDR. snippet they used: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-123 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0`
noah_net: we'll add two options: recommended CIDR example (e.g., 198.51.100.0/24) and a PrivateLink/VPC endpoint pattern + a short curl verify.
anya_sec: KMS: their role used `kms:*`  security flagged it. runbook needs least-priv sample and an explicit note about `kms:CreateGrant` when using temporary credentials. also capture rotation options: quarterly default, monthly requires rewrap window.
devin_platform: CloudTrail forward failed with AccessDenied writing to central bucket. runbook only says "enable CloudTrail"  we need a cross-account PutObject + PutObjectAcl example and prereqs: SSE, ObjectLock >=1y, block public access. common fix: missing PutObjectAcl or SSE mismatch.
runbot: Checklist updated: added placeholders "Telemetry CIDR/VPC endpoint", "KMS least-priv example", "CloudTrail cross-account policy". See /runbooks/cedarbridge-priv (draft).
claire_cs: next steps: noah to add network snippets + verify, anya to add KMS policy + rotation note, devin to add bucket policy + troubleshooting. I'll schedule a 30m sync with CedarBridge infra tomorrow 10:00 PT. tagging renewal_watch if they insist on monthly rotation without maintenance SLA.
noah_net: will post terraform and curl verify in PR.
anya_sec: I'll include `aws kms list-grants --key-id <id>` as a quick verification step.
claire_cs: thanks all  will send invite and close after a second dry-run.
